required_shims.reason: File-backed streams still sanitize the legacy media-file identity token so old persisted manifests remain startable.
required_shims.replace_with: Drop media-file token coercion after persisted file-stream manifests have been migrated to stable alias and hardware-id fields.

required_shims.reason: Media replay still guesses calibration from the only live/persisted calibrated camera when old media lacks stream-id metadata.
required_shims.replace_with: Require replay metadata to carry source stream identity and stop guessing calibration from unrelated cameras.

required_shims.reason: Replay still remuxes raw annex-b H264/H265 captures into MP4 as a compatibility bridge for older/offboard media archives.
required_shims.replace_with: Standardize replay inputs on supported containerized media and remove the on-demand remux cache.

required_shims.reason: helios-api still falls back to a temp data root when persistent partitions are unavailable during bring-up or tests.
required_shims.replace_with: Require a mounted persistent data root outside of explicit test overrides and fail startup instead of silently degrading to tmp.
